title: ECESpecialisationsAY202410July2024latest (pdf) - CliffsNotes
description: As at 10 July 2024 1 Specialisations for B.Eng.(EE) : EE AY2021 intake & after A Specialisation is a curated set of complementary courses. for EE students to develop expertise in a particular area of current interest in industry. By following a Specialisation, EE students acquire a relevant set of skills to contribute to and develop their careers in a certain sector in the electrical engineering industry. For each Specialisation, up to 8 Units (40% of the Units requirements for a Specialisation) may be double counted and used to meet (i) the Specialisation requirement and (ii) another requirement, e.g., General Education (only for students admitted from AY2021/2022 onwards), College (e.g., Common Curriculum), Faculty, Second Major, Minor, Specialisation or other requirement, i.e., at least 12 Units of the Specialisation must be distinct and not overlapping. As at 10 July 2024 2 Alternatively, students can choose not to follow the recommended Specialisations, but choose a subset of courses in a certain Specialisation(s) to pursue your interest, or you can also compose your own set of TEs to study an engineering area in depth.
